name: Goblin Foundry
summary: In the Deadmines, goblins keep the Goblin Foundry working for the Defias Brotherhood. Gilnid oversees craftsmen and engineers around a great smelting cauldron.

sections.title: Industrial Ambitions
sections.body: Deep beneath Moonbrook, goblin craftsmen and engineers work at the Goblin Foundry for the Defias Brotherhood. Smelters and iron ramps fill the chamber as they make anchors and cannonballs.

sections.title: Gilnid's Workshop
sections.body: Gilnid oversees the goblin workforce at the foundry. Craftsmen keep production moving, while engineers use remote-controlled golems to defend the workshop. Narrow ramps and molten metal make the chamber dangerous for intruders.

faq.q: What was being built in the Goblin Foundry?
faq.answer: Goblin craftsmen make heavy metalwork for the Defias Brotherhood, including anchors and cannonballs.

faq.q: Why are there golems in the foundry?
faq.answer: Goblin engineers use remote-controlled golems to defend their workshop from intruders.

faq.q: Where are the goblins who ran this workshop?
faq.answer: The goblin craftsmen and engineers are still at work in the foundry under Gilnid, the smelter.

faq.q: What is the large structure in the center of the room?
faq.answer: A massive industrial smelting cauldron dominates the room's center. It melts ore hauled from the mines to forge armor plates and mechanical chassis.

angles.text: The foundry shows goblin metalworking and mechanical skill. Its engineers use remote-controlled golems to defend the workshop.
Beneath Westfall, the Defias workshop reveals the scale of the Brotherhood's industrial resources.
